class.name: IfcOpenShell
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : An open shell is a shell of the dimensionality 2. Its domain, if present, is a finite, connected, oriented, 2-manifold with boundary, but is not a closed surface. It can be thought of as a closed shell with one or more holes punched in it.
